# SceneTemplateAsset

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.SceneBuilding` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/SceneBuilder/Scene/SceneTemplateAsset.cs#L18)

A scene template authored in the project rather than in code. This is what makes templates
lasting rather than one-off: capture a scene you are happy with, keep the asset, apply it to
the next scene and the one after that, and hand it to whoever builds the next module.
Create one from Assets > Create > VR Framework > Scene Builder > Scene Template, or from the
"Save Scene as Template" card in the Scene Builder.


## Methods

### CaptureActiveScene() {#captureactivescene}

Writes a template describing what the open scene currently contains: every installer that
reports itself satisfied, in installer order. Returns the created asset, or null when the
user cancelled or nothing was recognised.
